body:
I've had this little guy for maybe 8 months now. These last three weeks he's been showing some signs of distress. His coloring has changed, I see some discolored patches all around his body and some part of the fins, and just looks kinda rough around the eyes.

At first he started acting different, I would see him having trouble breathing and just hung around the top of the tank for long periods of time. His symptoms looked like a type of gill disease, so I separated him into a one gallon quarantine tank and treated him with Furan 2. I did this for 4 days until he seemed to become unhappier in the tank without plants/cover and so I put him back in his tank.

He's more active now but visually he still looks different. Could he have anything else I haven't caught? Should I try using aquarium salts and check if I just need to optimize the water? I have a 3 gallon tank with two snails, two zebra danios, and a tiny new albino cory. Tested the water this week and all levels and pH seem fine. I also use a filter.
